title: Haloumi Pasta
subtitle: with Ratatouille Sauce
description: Want something fresh and tasty for dinner? Brimming with golden pan-fried haloumi, eggplant, capsicum and basil, this Italian-inspired pasta dish is just the ticket.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Bring a medium saucepan of salted water to the boil for the pasta. Cut half the eggplant (see Cooking tip) into 1.5cm chunks. Cut the capsicum into 2cm chunks. Pick the parsley leaves and finely chop the stems. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Slice the haloumi.
Cook pasta: Cook the pasta in the pan of boiling water for 10 mins or until al dente. Reserve 60ml (¼ cup) cooking water, then drain the pasta.

Start sauce: Meanwhile, heat 1 tbs olive oil in a medium deep frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the eggplant and capsicum, stirring occasionally, for 8 mins or until just tender. Add the parsley stems, garlic and 2 tbs tomato paste and cook, stirring, for 2 mins.

Finish sauce: Add the tomatoes, 2 tsp red wine vinegar, ½ tsp sugar and the reserved cooking water to the capsicum mixture. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to medium and cook for 8 mins or until the sauce is slightly thickened. Stir in the pasta. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper.

Serve up: Meanwhile, heat 2 tsp olive oil in a small frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the haloumi for 1-2 mins each side until golden. Remove from the pan. Divide the pasta among bowls, top with the fried haloumi, scatter over the parsley leaves and enjoy!
Make it yours: For a spicy kick, sprinkle with chilli flakes before serving.
